texts.zh: 虽然我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的契约本质是军事上的，但我们没有想到它会对我们产生如此恶劣的影响。我们的人民因宗主国的不断要求而受苦，我们的一些顾问推测，如果这种情况继续下去，将对我们的长期计划产生永久性影响。
texts.en: Though our agreement with [overlord_empire.GetName] is militaristic in nature, we did not expect the atrocious effects it would have on us. Our people are suffering with the constant demands from our overlord, and some of our advisors speculate that if it continues for much longer it will have a permanent impact on our long-term plans.

texts.zh: 虽然我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的契约本质是军事上的，我们既没有计划也没有预见到它会给我们带来的残酷影响。由于我们一直在与宗主国的要求作抗争，我们的许多内部计划不得不搁置，只为应付我们军队的大量需求。
texts.en: Though our agreement with the [overlord_empire.GetName] is militaristic in nature, we had neither planned nor foreseen the atrocious impact it would have on us. As we are constantly struggling with the demands of our overlord, our many internal plans have to be set aside in order to manage the extensive needs of our military.

label.en: We will have to live with it.

texts.zh: 我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]，已经向我们发送了一个公报，报告了由于我们迫使他们介入战争从而导致的国内冲突。在充分理解了之前所同意的外交契约的性质后，他们开始要求我们为了他们的利益而改变政策，这让人有些吃惊。
texts.en: Our vassal, [subject_empire.GetName], has sent us a messenger with a detailed communiqué about the struggles their empire is going through because of the wars we have forced them into. Knowing the nature of the diplomatic contract they agreed to, it comes as a bit of a surprise that they have started asking us to change our policies for their sake.

label.zh: 我们将向他们保证会对此开展调查。
label.en: We will assure them that we will look into it.

label.zh: 他们的冲突是他们自己的事情。

tooltips.zh: [subject_empire.GetName]可能会因为我们无视他们的困境而失去忠诚。
tooltips.en: The [subject_empire.GetName] might lose loyalty because of our choice to ignore their plights.

texts.zh: 我们收到了来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的礼貌回复。回复中解释说他们将研究如何解决目前的外交状况，并在下一步的计划中把我们的问题考虑进去。
texts.en: We have received a respectful response from [overlord_empire.GetName], explaining that they will look into what they can do about their current diplomatic situation, and that they will take our problems into consideration moving forward.

texts.zh:
尽管我们的公报详细解释了情况，但似乎我们在[overlord_empire.GetName]的盟友根本不关心我们的问题。如果他们好战本性继续不减，我们的人民一定会受苦。

没过多久，宗主国的回应和我们当前困境的细节就为公众所知。我们注意到一个反对[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]继续统治的小政治团体的崛起。他们显然对安抚我们毫无兴趣，那么我们对他们的忠诚到底能换来什么呢?
texts.en:
Despite our detailed communiqué explaining the situation, it seems our ally in the [overlord_empire.GetName] cares naught for our problems. If their warlike nature continues unabated, our people are sure to suffer.

It does not take long before the response from our overlord as well as the details of our current predicament becomes public knowledge, and we see the rise of a small political group opposing the continued rule from [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]. They are clearly disinterested in appeasing us at all, so what do we truly get from staying loyal to them?

texts.zh:
尽管我们的公报详细而简洁地解释了情况，但似乎我们的守护者[overlord_empire.GetName]已经选择无视我们的困境。他们不仅不关心我们的忠诚，他们似乎决心继续他们目前的破坏性行径。

虽然最初与他们签署契约时，我们希望有一个更好的结果，但我们目前的计算表明，它将对我们的帝国造成持续困扰。
texts.en:
Despite our detailed yet concise communiqué explaining the situation, it seems our caretaker in the [overlord_empire.GetName] has chosen to ignore our plight. Not only do they not care about our loyalties, they seem determined to continue on their current destructive path.

Though we had hoped for a better outcome when we first signed our agreements with them, all our current calculations point to the continued problematic effect it would have on our empire.

label.zh: 我们还不能反抗我们的宗主。
label.en: Yet we cannot oppose our overlord.

texts.zh: 看来我们的驳回已经在[subject_empire.GetName]引发了一个小小的抗议政治运动。虽然他们对我们的回应不太满意，但该运动也还在努力寻找立足之处，而他们的帝国总的来说也没有反对我们统治的能力。
texts.en: It seems our dismissal has given rise to a small political movement opposing us in the [subject_empire.GetName]. Though they are less than pleased with our response, the movement is struggling to find ground, and their empire as a whole is not capable of opposing our rule.

texts.zh: 看来我们的驳回已经让[subject_empire.GetRulerTitle]开始质疑我们继续统治他们的正当性。虽然从目前的情况看，他们可能对我们的外交契约犹豫不决，但还没有到可以反对的地步。
texts.en: It seems our dismissal has given the [subject_empire.GetRulerTitle] doubts about our right to continue ruling over them. Though they might harbor hesitation about our diplomatic contract as of right now, they are not in a position where they can oppose us yet.

label.en: Their continued subjugation is a given.
